title: Corrections to a published meeting
description: Notes written after a meeting was published, so that the following meetings work from correct information. The published draft itself never changes. Written by the application to work/corrections.json of the meeting.

date.description: The day the correction was written

item.description: The item of the meeting this corrects, when it is about one

issue.description: An issue this corrects, for example #12; when absent and an item is given, the issue made from that item is used
